reuse.why: Uses the existing getFillableCategories selection, getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator/undoable wiring; only the income-skip check and sign flip are written inline, as every sibling action already does.

duplication.why: Repeats the per-category `is_income && !isTrackingBudget()` skip and the expense sign flip that set3MonthAvg/setNMonthAvg also hand-code, but no larger block is copied.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts like them.

scope.why: Only the action, its registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with its siblings; the income rule and sign convention remain re-stated per action rather than shared.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getFillableCategories and writes through setBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated income-skip/sign-flip lines are written openly in the same form as the sibling actions.
